blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.
blocks.zh: 近期在以文字为指南的3D编辑方面的进步,特别是3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS),显示出了希望,但仍落后于2D编辑工具的灵活性. 现有方法在保持多视图一致性和允许结构修改之间面临关键的取舍。 基于图像的编辑器也可能在将预定的编辑应用到从不同寻常的角度所查看的对象上上上挣扎. 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了VidEdit3D,这个框架将3D场景编辑重新设定为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务. 通过在静态3D场景中的相机运动和视频中的时间动力学之间画出一个平行,我们利用预先训练的视频传播模型(VDMs)的强势的spatiotimal前传,鼓励各种观点的语义和结构一致性. 具体地说,我们提议采用 " Tropjectory-Guided Redowering " (TGR)来选择信息化的键框,并构建符合VDM输入要求的平滑视频剪辑. 为了将编辑从主播视图传播到这些剪辑,我们开发了Flow-Accessed Video Edition(FAVE),这是一个包含编辑一致性指导(ECG)机制的无培训框架. ECG在共享潜伏状态下对比出源和被编辑的图像条件,使用计划源图像放大来强化对被编辑的参考的遵守,同时保持原景上下文. 最后,我们引入了Region-Selective 3DGS Finalment(RS-GS),严格将几何和外观更新限制在目标原始人,减少背景属性泄漏. 实验显示,比起基线,指令更加一致,多视图一致性更好.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in text-guided image editing have demonstrated remarkable success in enabling users to modify images according to natural language instructions [ 3 , 14 , 43 ] .
By leveraging large-scale diffusion or transformer-based models, these systems can generate semantically aligned and visually coherent edits, such as replacing objects, altering styles, or modifying attributes, while preserving content fidelity.
This paradigm has significantly democratized content creation, making intuitive visual editing accessible to non-experts.
Building upon this progress, researchers have recently extended text-driven editing to the 3D domain, particularly in neural implicit representations such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) [ 36 ] and explicit point-based representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 18 ] .
Particularly, compared with NeRF, 3DGS offers greater flexibility and efficiency as an explicit 3D representation, enabling high-quality real-time rendering and fine-grained local editing. These advantages make 3DGS editing an attractive paradigm for controllable 3D content manipulation, which is the focus of our paper.
blocks.zh:
最近在文本引导图像编辑方面取得的进展表明,在使用户能够根据自然语言指令修改图像[3、14、43]方面取得了显著成功。
通过利用大规模扩散或基于变压器的模型,这些系统可以产生精致的对齐和视觉连贯的编辑,如替换对象,改变风格,或修改属性,同时保留内容忠贞性.
这种范式使内容创作显著民主化,使得直观的视觉编辑可以被非专家所利用.
在这一进展的基础上,研究人员最近将文本驱动编辑扩展至3D域,特别是在神经辐射场(NERFs)[36]等神经隐含表示以及3D高斯镀板(3DGS)[18]等明确的点表示.
特别是,与NERF相比,3DGS作为明确的3D代表提供了更大的灵活性和效率,使得能够进行高质量的实时渲染和精细的本地编辑. 这些优势使得3DGS编辑成为可控3D内容操纵的有吸引力的范例,这也是我们论文的重点.

blocks.en:
However, despite the potential of 3DGS, the capabilities of existing 3D editing frameworks still lag significantly behind their 2D counterparts. Many 3D editing methods focus on operations such as global style transfer, texture modification, or object removal. This stands in stark contrast to state-of-the-art 2D editing tools, which support highly imaginative and complex transformations with ease. A primary bottleneck restricting 3D editing flexibility is the requirement for multi-view consistency; unlike 2D editing, modifying a 3D scene requires simultaneous adjustments across multiple viewpoints while ensuring the underlying geometry remains coherent. Early attempts that naively applied 2D editors independently across different views inherently lacked cross-view coherence [ 13 , 9 , 47 ] , leading to severe artifacts such as ghosting and flickering.
To mitigate these inconsistencies, subsequent works [ 53 , 49 , 8 ] introduced geometric guidance through depth or correspondence with the original images. While these constraints stabilize the optimization process, strong alignment to the source can limit editing flexibility. This limitation becomes particularly evident in instructions that require structural changes. For instance, a simple instruction like “make the person wear a hat” becomes difficult to execute when the required geometric addition conflicts with alignment constraints derived from the original shape.
blocks.zh:
然而,尽管有3DGS的潜力,现有的3D编辑框架的能力仍然大大落后于其2D对应方. 许多3D编辑方法侧重于全局样式传输,纹理修改,或对象删除等操作. 这与最先进的2D编辑工具形成鲜明对比,这些工具可以轻松地支持高度想象力和复杂的转换. 限制3D编辑灵活性的主要瓶颈是需要多视图一致性;与2D编辑不同,修改3D场景需要跨多个视角同时调整,同时确保基础几何保持一致性. 早期的尝试,天真地在不同观点上独立应用2D编辑,内在缺乏交叉视野的一致性[13,9,47],导致鬼魂和闪烁等严重文物.
为了减轻这些不一致之处,后来的作品[53,49,8]通过深度或与原始图像的对应,引入了几何指导. 虽然这些限制稳定了优化过程,但与源的紧密配合会限制编辑的灵活性. 这种限制在需要结构改革的指示中特别明显。 例如,“使个人戴帽子”这样的简单指令在所需几何加法与原形状产生的校正限制发生冲突时就难以执行。

blocks.en: Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles, especially when the relevant parts are partly or fully hidden. For example, an instruction such as “put glasses on a bear” is readily interpreted from a frontal view but becomes ambiguous from a rear view, where the face is occluded. 3D editing therefore needs to propagate a clearly specified edit across views while accounting for which object parts are visible.
blocks.zh: 基于图像的编辑器也会挣扎将预期的编辑应用到从不寻常角度查看的对象,特别是在相关部分被部分或完全隐藏的情况下. 例如,“把眼镜放在熊上”这样的指示很容易从正面角度加以解释,但从后面角度则变得模糊不清,因为脸部被遮住。 因此3D编辑需要在视图中传播一个明确指定的编辑,同时说明哪些对象部分是可见的.

blocks.en: These limitations motivate the design of a flexible 3D editing framework capable of performing precise semantic manipulations without the excessive rigidity of geometric locks. To achieve this, we introduce VidEdit3D (Fig. 1 ), which takes an edit created in a single view with a 2D editor, propagates it across viewpoints, and reconstructs the edited 3D scene. To robustly facilitate this propagation, we identify a powerful parallel between temporal consistency in videos and multi-view consistency in the rendered frames of a 3D scene. A camera trajectory moving around a static 3D object yields a sequence of frames that is structurally analogous to a video clip. This insight inspires us to leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) [ 44 , 22 , 2 , 16 , 58 ] . VDMs are designed to maintain object identity and semantic coherence across time, providing a useful prior for relating 3D viewpoints. ViP3DE [ 6 ] also propagates a single edited view into 3D using motion-preserved noise blending and geometry-aware denoising. VidEdit3D strengthens reference transfer through an explicit contrast between source and edited image conditions, while spatial source regularization preserves the surrounding scene. Our inversion-free formulation allows the edited region to change without enforcing source-geometry feature correspondences during denoising. In our comparisons, VidEdit3D achieves stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than ViP3DE, including when both use the same video backbone.
blocks.zh: 这些限制促使设计了一个灵活的3D编辑框架,能够进行精确的语义操控,而无需过硬的几何锁. 为此,我们引入了VidEdit3D(图1),它用2D编辑器在单一视图中创建的编辑,在观点上传播,并重建编辑过的3D场景. 为了大力促进这种传播,我们发现视频中的时间一致性与三维场景的多视图一致性之间有着强大的平行。 环绕静态3D物体移动的相机轨迹产生一系列与视频剪辑结构相似的帧. 这一见解激励我们利用预先训练过的视频传播模型[44, 22, 2, 16, 58] 的强劲的瞬间前奏。 VDM旨在保持对象身份和语义的跨时间一致性,为关联的3D观点提供有用的前置. ViP3DE [6]还利用运动预留噪声混合和几何感知解析,将单个编辑的视图传播到3D. 视频编辑3 D通过源头和编辑图像条件之间的明显对比加强参考传输,而空间源规范化则保留了周围的场景. 我们的无反向配方允许编辑区域在解密时不强制执行源几何特征通信而改变. 在我们的比较中,VidEdit3D实现了比ViP3DE更强的指令对齐和更好的多视图一致性,包括当两者使用相同的视频主干线时.

blocks.en: To transform sparse 3D renderings into a form compatible with video diffusion models, we introduce a Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) strategy. Starting from a user-selected anchor, TGR selects views of the source subject carrying the edit and connects them into a smooth camera trajectory. We propagate along two branches from the anchor to shorten the sequence of transfers to distant views and reduce error accumulation. Overlapping clips maintain continuity within each branch while matching video diffusion priors.
blocks.zh: 为了将稀疏的3D渲染转换成一种与视频传播模型兼容的形式,我们引入了Traphory-Guided Rendering(TGR)策略. 从用户选择的主锚开始,TGR会选择带编辑器的源主题的视图,并将其连接到一个平滑的相机轨迹中. 我们沿着两个分支从锚地传播,以缩短向远处转移的顺序,并减少错误的积累。 重叠片段在每个分支内部保持连续性,同时匹配视频传播前传.

blocks.en: To propagate edits from a key view to the rendered video clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework inspired by recent inversion-free editing methods [ 19 , 25 ] . Unlike prior methods that are primarily guided by text, our goal is to leverage the strong generative and editing capabilities of 2D image editing models to transfer a user-specified edit from one anchor view to the full 3D scene.
blocks.zh: 为了将编辑从关键视图传播到已制作的视频剪辑,我们开发了Flow-Accessed Video Edition(FAVE),这是受最近无倒置编辑方法启发的无培训框架[19,25]. 与以往主要以文本为指南的方法不同,我们的目标是利用2D图像编辑模型强大的基因和编辑能力,将用户指定的编辑从一个主播视图转移到完整的3D场景.

blocks.en: In standard image-to-video (I2V) generation, classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 15 ] evaluates the denoiser twice under different text conditions, while both evaluations typically share the same first-frame image as the temporal anchor. This design is effective for video synthesis, since a fixed first-frame condition helps preserve object identity and temporal coherence over time. In contrast, FAVE, as an inversion-free editing method, conceptually requires two distinct conditioning roles: one should follow the edited reference frame and target prompt, while the other should preserve the original scene structure under the source frame and source prompt. However, directly reusing the standard I2V conditioning scheme in our setting leads both evaluations to remain anchored to the same edited first frame, rather than forming the desired source-versus-target contrast. In I2V models, this mismatch is exacerbated by the strong first-frame anchoring effect: later frames remain strongly influenced by the first-frame image condition, which can make the two evaluations inherit similar image-conditioned components and weaken the intended guidance contrast. To address this issue, we introduce Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG), a training-free inference-time guidance scheme that restores a meaningful source-versus-edit contrast in the guidance computation. Specifically, ECG amplifies the source concatenation condition early in sampling, then replaces it with edited-frame features while retaining source text and cross-attention conditioning. FAVE complements this guidance with source-sequence and spatial constraints that preserve camera motion and unedited content.
blocks.zh: 在标准图像到视频(I2V)生成中,分类器无引导器(CFG)[15]在不同的文本条件下两次评价denoiser,而两种评价通常与时标共用相同的第一帧图像. 这种设计对于视频合成是有效的,因为固定的第一帧条件有助于随着时间的推移保持对象身份和时间一致性. 相比之下,FAVE作为一种无倒置的编辑方法,在概念上需要两个截然不同的调节角色:一个应该遵循编辑后的参考框架和目标提示,另一个应该按照源框架和源提示保留原始的场景结构. 然而,在我们的设定中直接使用标准I2V调制方案,导致两个评价仍然固定在同一经编辑的第一个框架,而不是形成理想的源与目标对比。 在I2V模型中,这种不匹配因强烈的第一帧锚定效应而加剧:后帧仍然受到第一帧影像条件的强烈影响,这可以使两个评价继承类似的图像条件组件,并削弱预定的指导对比. 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了编辑一致性指导(ECG),这是一种无培训推论-时间指导计划,在指导计算中恢复了有意义的源与编辑的对比. 具体地说,ECG在采样早期就放大了源调适条件,然后用编辑的帧特性来取代,同时保留源文本和交叉调适条件. FAVE用源序列和空间限制来补充这一指导,保留了相机运动和未经编辑的内容.

blocks.en: During 3D optimization, existing 3D editing methods [ 9 , 49 , 8 , 53 , 26 ] can suffer from global attribute leakage, where gradients intended for the target object erroneously update the entire scene. Explicit spatial control keeps the refinement localized to the intended target. To address this issue, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS), a method that explicitly constrains the refinement to the target region by back-projecting 2D segmentation masks into 3D space and using depth-guided filtering to select the corresponding Gaussians. By confining the optimization to these back-projected primitives while freezing all others, RS-GS ensures that geometric and appearance updates are confined to the edited regions.
blocks.zh: 在3D优化期间,现有的3D编辑方法[9,49,8,53,26]可能会受到全球属性渗漏的影响,其中针对目标对象的梯度会错误地更新整个场景. 明确的空间控制使精细化达到预定目标。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Region-Selective 3DGS Findinement(RS-GS),这种方法通过将2D分割口罩反射到3D空间,使用深度制导过滤来选择相应的高斯人来明确限制对目标区域的完善. RS-GS通过将这些优化限制在这些反投影原始物上,同时冻结所有其他原始物,确保几何和外观更新仅限于编辑区域.

blocks.en:
In summary, VidEdit3D effectively reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task.
Our main contributions are: • We propose VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D editing as video editing to propagate a reference edit consistently across viewpoints. • We design TGR to select informative keyframes and organize them into smooth video clips, improving their compatibility with pretrained I2V priors. • We develop FAVE with ECG, a training-free mechanism that combines scheduled source–edit image conditioning with a separate source-trajectory constraint to enable precise edit propagation. • We design RS-GS refinement to confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. • Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the compared baselines.
blocks.zh:
简而言之,VidEdit3D有效重塑了3D场景编辑,作为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务.
我们的主要贡献是: • 我们提议VidEdit3D,这个框架将3D编辑改编为视频编辑,以在各种观点之间一致地传播参考编辑。 我们设计TGR来选择信息化的密钥框,并将其组织成平滑的视频片段,提高它们与预先训练的I2V前传的兼容性. ^ . 我们与ECG一起开发FAVE,这是一种无培训机制,它将预定源-编辑图像条件与单独的源-导电限制结合起来,以便能够进行精确的编辑传播。 我们设计RS-GS改进,将几何和外观更新限制在目标原始人,减少背景属性泄漏. • 实验显示,比起比较基线,指令更加一致,多种观点更加一致。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A significant body of work has explored editing 3D scenes (NeRFs [ 36 ] or 3DGS [ 18 ] ) through optimization or distillation strategies.
Early implicit approaches relied on mesh scaffolds or interactive distillation [ 60 , 17 ] , while subsequent explicit methods utilize iterative optimization to distill 2D diffusion priors into 3D representations [ 9 , 23 , 47 ] .
Recent advancements further enhance quality through identity-preserving noise estimation [ 20 ] or task-specific optimization for style transfer and virtual try-on [ 32 , 5 ] .
However, ensuring multi-view consistency remains a primary bottleneck.
To address this, several methods use geometric guidance such as depth or epipolar alignment [ 53 , 8 , 49 , 26 , 12 ] .
Some methods use per-scene fine-tuning [ 50 , 65 ] , while others train generalized multi-view editors on paired data [ 61 , 7 ] . ViP3DE [ 6 ] propagates an edited view through motion-preserved noise blending and geometry-aware denoising. VidEdit3D uses inversion-free source–edit conditioning to drive the requested change, together with spatial source regularization that is weaker inside the edited region and stronger outside it. This separates edit transfer from preservation of surrounding content, and our comparisons with ViP3DE show gains in both instruction alignment and multi-view consistency.
blocks.zh:
大量工作通过优化或蒸馏策略探索了编辑3D场景(NERFs[36]或3DGS[18]).
早期隐含的方法依赖于网格脚手架或交互式蒸馏[60,17],而随后的显式方法则利用迭代优化将2D扩散前缀提炼成3D表示[9,23,47].
近期的进步通过身份保存噪声估计[20]或针对特定任务优化样式传输和虚拟尝试[32,5]进一步提高了质量.
然而,确保多种观点的一致性仍然是一个主要瓶颈。
为了解决这一问题,几种方法采用几何指导,如深度或极地对齐[53、8、49、26、12]。
有些方法使用单色微调[50,65],而其他方法则在配对数据上训练通用多视图编辑器[61,7]. ViP3DE [6]通过运动预留噪声混合和几何感知解析来传播编辑后的视图. 视频编辑3 D使用无反向源–编辑调制来驱动所请求的改变,同时空间源规范化在编辑区域内部较弱,在编辑区域外较强. 这将编辑传输与周边内容的保存区分开来,我们与ViP3DE的比较显示在指令对齐和多视图一致性两方面都取得了收益.

blocks.en: For image editing, SDEdit balances realism and fidelity through noising and denoising [ 35 ] . With diffusion transformer (DiT) backbones and rectified flows [ 38 , 34 ] , later methods reduce inversion drift through ODE solvers, noise alignment [ 10 , 46 , 55 ] , or history-guided velocity correction [ 45 ] . Other methods preserve structure through attention and feature control [ 14 , 43 , 29 ] . MasaCtrl supports non-rigid edits with mutual self-attention [ 4 ] , while KV-Edit and FreeFlux use DiT-specific key-value reuse for background-preserving, task-adaptive editing [ 64 , 52 ] . Video editing adds temporal coherence: cross-frame attention control and fusion [ 33 , 39 ] and space-time modulation [ 57 ] reduce drift and improve fine-grained control. I2V methods propagate first-frame edits using temporal features or motion–content alignment [ 24 , 30 ] , whereas FlowDirector uses inversion-free ODE steering [ 27 ] . Complex motion and large appearance or shape changes remain challenging.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Overview of VidEdit3D. We reformulate 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. The pipeline consists of three key stages: (1) TGR : We organize selected views into smooth video clips. (2) FAVE : Given a user-edited anchor frame, we propagate the edit across the clip using a pretrained VDM. This module incorporates ECG for semantic alignment and a self-attention-based mask for background preservation. (3) RS-GS : We lift the 2D edits back to 3D via inverse rendering to confine updates to the target Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 图2:VidEdit3D概览. 我们重塑3D场景编辑,作为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务. 管道包括三个关键阶段: (1) TGR: 我们把部分观点组织成平滑的视频片段。 (2)FAVE :鉴于一个用户编辑的锚定框,我们使用预先训练的VDM在剪辑片断上传播编辑内容. 该模块包含用于语义对齐的ECG和用于背景保存的基于自觉的面具. (3) RS-GS: 我们通过反向渲染将2D编辑器提升回3D,将更新限制在目标高斯人身上.

blocks.en: Given a reconstructed 3D Gaussian scene, calibrated source views, an edited anchor image, and source and target prompts, VidEdit3D produces an edited 3D scene. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , our pipeline consists of three stages: (1) TGR converts selected multi-view renderings into smooth video clips; (2) FAVE propagates edits across the clip through a trajectory-regularized flow formulation, augmented with ECG for semantic alignment and a dynamic attention mask for background preservation; and (3) RS-GS lifts the edited frames back into 3D via depth-constrained back-projection, confining updates to the target Gaussians to preserve scene-wide consistency.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个重建的3D高斯场景,校准了源视图,一个编辑的锚定图像,以及源和目标提示,VidEdit3D产生了一个编辑过的3D场景. 如图2所示,我们的管道由三个阶段组成:(1) TGR将选定的多视图渲染转换成平滑的视频剪辑;(2) FAVE通过轨迹规范流配法传播整个剪辑的编辑,并辅以ECG用于语义对齐和动态注意力罩用于背景保存;(3) RS-GS通过深度限制后投影将剪辑的帧抬回3D,将更新限制在目标高斯人身上,以保持全场的一致性.

blocks.en: To exploit the spatiotemporal priors of video diffusion models for 3D editing, we need to reduce the mismatch between multi-view renderings and the smooth temporal patterns commonly observed in natural videos. When consecutive camera views are far apart or presented in an irregular order, objects can shift abruptly in the image or reveal different surfaces between frames. An I2V model may then produce inconsistent appearances or shapes for the same object across views. TGR addresses this mismatch by selecting informative views and connecting them into smooth camera trajectories for edit propagation.

blocks.en: 3.3 Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE)
blocks.zh: 3.3 流程同步视频编辑(FAVE)

blocks.en: A central challenge in our setting is that the rendered multi-view sequence corresponds to a static 3D scene observed along a camera trajectory. Therefore, during edit propagation, the desired variation should come from viewpoint change alone, while the subject layout, pose, and spatial placement should remain stable across frames. In practice, however, off-the-shelf video editing models [ 57 , 48 , 11 , 27 , 30 ] often introduce spurious object motion or geometric drift, which is particularly harmful for 3D editing.
blocks.zh: 我们设置中的一项中心挑战是 制成的多视图序列 与一个静态的三维场景 相机轨迹上观测到的 因此,在编辑传播过程中,所希望的变化应当仅从观点出发,而主题布局、布局和空间布局应当保持跨框架的稳定。 然而实际上,现成的视频编辑模型[57,48,11,27,30]往往引入假物体运动或几何漂移,这对3D编辑特别有害.

blocks.en: To address this issue, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free propagation framework that adapts trajectory regularization to I2V editing. Our design is inspired by FlowAlign [ 19 ] , which regularizes editing trajectories toward structurally consistent solutions in image editing. We incorporate its source-consistency principle into a coupled source/target propagation process tailored to video-conditioned denoising, enabling a user-specified edit to propagate along a multi-view video trajectory while suppressing undesired subject motion.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们开发了Flow-Accessed Video edition(FAVE),这是一个免费的传播框架,将轨迹规范化适用于I2V编辑. 我们的设计灵感来自FlowAlign[19], 我们将其源一致性原则纳入一个针对视频条件的去诺化的结合源/目标传播过程,使用户专用的编辑能够沿着多视图视频轨迹进行传播,同时抑制不受欢迎的主题运动。

blocks.en:
In standard I2V generation, classifier-free guidance (CFG) performs two denoiser evaluations under different text conditions while sharing the same first-frame visual anchor. In our setting, however, this formulation is problematic when computing the guided prediction v p v_{p} for edit propagation. In FAVE, an inversion-free editing method, the two guidance evaluations are intended to play different roles: the target-conditioned prediction should follow the edited first frame and target prompt, whereas the source-conditioned reference should preserve the original scene structure using the source first frame and prompt. Specifically, the first-frame image is injected into the I2V model through two visual conditioning pathways: cross-attention and concatenation. We denote the first-frame features supplied through these pathways by 𝐞 attn \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{attn}} and 𝐞 cat \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{cat}} , respectively. If both denoiser evaluations are conditioned on the edited first-frame features, the strong first-frame anchoring effect in I2V models causes the two predictions to inherit nearly the same image-driven bias. As a result, the source-to-target discrepancy in the guidance residual can be suppressed, weakening the editing signal.
To obtain v p v_{p} , ECG contrasts two predictions at the same edited state 𝐩 k \mathbf{p}_{k} . blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented VidEdit3D, which reformulates reference-guided 3D scene editing as I2V propagation by bridging static multi-view observations with the spatiotemporal priors of pretrained video diffusion models. TGR organizes selected 3D views into coherent video-like streams for edit propagation. FAVE enables robust semantic propagation through an inversion-free flow formulation, while ECG uses scheduled image conditioning to maintain a clearer source-to-target direction in DiT-based I2V models. RS-GS confines updates to target regions during final 3D optimization, reducing background leakage and better preserving unedited scene content. Together, these components enable high-fidelity, view-consistent edits across diverse viewpoints and challenging structural modifications without network fine-tuning. VidEdit3D shows how pretrained video priors support flexible 3D editing.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VidEdit3D,它通过将静态多视图观测与预先训练的视频传播模型的前身连接起来,将参考制导的3D场景编辑为I2V传播. TGR将选定的3D视图组织成连贯的视频类流进行编辑传播. FAVE通过无反向流配方实现强力语义传播,而ECG则使用预定的图像调制,在基于DiT的I2V模型中保持更清晰的源对目标方向. RS-GS在最终3D优化时将更新限制在目标区域,减少背景渗漏,更好地保存未经编辑的场景内容. 这些组件加在一起,可以实现高真实性,不同观点的视线一致的编辑,以及挑战性的结构修改而无需网络微调. 视频编辑3 D显示预训视频前传支持灵活3D编辑的方式.

blocks.en: The edited anchor conditions the I2V backbone, while the rendered source clip guides scene preservation. Source and edited states share noise at each denoising step; ECG amplifies source concatenation features early in sampling. blocks.en: We use N = 4 N=4 keyframes for small scenes and N = 7 N=7 for large scenes, including the user-selected anchor in both cases. The keyframe count is fixed for each scene. Candidate views are screened using CLIP ViT-H/14 similarity to a description of the source subject carrying the edit. A view is retained when its similarity is at least 0.15 and at least 0.74 times the source anchor similarity. For example, adding glasses uses a description of the person’s head. We also project the reconstructed subject points into each candidate camera and require at least 90% of these points to lie in front of the camera and inside the image. We exclude views where the projected subject occupies too little or too much of the image, or lies too far from the image center. Duplicate camera poses are removed.

blocks.en: The edited anchor determines the visual content transferred to the 3D scene. Background artifacts and incomplete object removal in the anchor can therefore persist after propagation and 3D refinement. A clean, target-visible anchor reduces these errors, and stronger 2D editors can be incorporated without retraining the propagation model. RS-GS preserves the attributes of unselected Gaussians, although their rendered visibility can change as the edited target changes shape.
blocks.zh: 编辑主播决定了转移到3D场景的视觉内容. 因此,在传播和3D精细化后,主锚上的背景文物和不完全的物体清除可以持续下去。 一个干净的,目标可见的锚可以减少这些错误,更强大的2D编辑器可以在不重新培训传播模型的情况下被吸收. RS-GS保留了未选取的高斯人属性,尽管其渲染的能见度会随着编辑目标形状的变化而改变.

blocks.en: E.2 Large-Area Appearance Edits
blocks.zh: E.2 大面积外观版

blocks.en: Large-area texture or style edits leave little unchanged context to anchor propagation. FAVE uses source-consistency regularization to preserve scene layout, but transferring a new appearance across substantial visibility changes becomes harder when most visible surfaces are edited. The target appearance can then drift or fade toward the source appearance in later views. Fig. 11 illustrates this dependence on scene context.
blocks.zh: 大区域纹理或样式编辑对播映几乎没有改变。 FAVE使用源一致性规范来保持场景布局,但当大多数可见的表面被编辑时,通过实质性的可见度变化来转移新的外观变得更加困难. 目标外观在后来的视图中可以漂移或向源的外观淡化. 图11说明了这种对现场环境的依赖。

blocks.en: A wider rendering field of view introduces more unedited context and can help sustain the target appearance along the trajectory. This reduces the target’s image resolution, however, making fine-grained appearance transfer less accurate after 3D refinement. Balancing contextual support with target resolution remains a direction for improving large-area editing.
blocks.zh: 一个更广泛的渲染视野引入了更多未经编辑的上下文,有助于在轨迹上保持目标外观. 然而,这降低了目标图像分辨率,使得精细的外观在3D精细化后转移更不准确. 在背景支持与目标分辨率之间保持平衡仍然是改进大面积编辑工作的一个方向。

blocks.en: E.3 Editing Time
blocks.zh: E.3 编辑时间

blocks.en: Computational efficiency remains a limitation. Our Wan2.1-I2V-14B backbone requires repeated denoiser evaluations over dense multi-view clips, making interactive editing costly. Sparse attention [ 54 , 56 , 28 ] , feature caching [ 31 , 63 ] , model distillation [ 59 ] , and learned few-step solvers [ 62 ] offer promising ways to reduce this cost. Integrating these techniques while preserving reference fidelity and multi-view consistency is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 计算效率仍然是一个限制。 我们的Wan2.1-I2V-14B主干需要针对密集的多视图剪辑进行反复的Denoiser评价,因此互动编辑费用昂贵. [54, 56, 28], 特征缓冲 [31, 63], 模型蒸馏 [59], 和学习的几步解析器 [62] 提供了降低这一成本的有希望的方法. 综合这些技术,同时保持参考忠诚和多观点一致性,是今后工作的一个重要方向。
